extension.description: Language support and build tooling for Minecraft Resourcepack Generation Language (RSGL).
config.title: RSGL
config.desc.outDir: Output directory for generated resource pack files. Empty uses the nearest pack.mcmeta directory.
config.desc.defaultAssetsPath: Fallback vanilla assets path used when validating generated references. Empty disables the vanilla assets fallback.
config.desc.resourcePackLoadOrder: Additional resource pack roots used when validating generated references.
